root.label: Saxony sends Christmas stollen to Pope Leo XIV

events.label: Saxony sends Christmas stollen to Pope Leo XIV

slots.name: cake weight
slots.sentence: The 4-kilogram (8.8-pound) cake, a so-called stollen, which was made in the Ore Mountains in eastern Germany, was taken by Saxon Premier Michael Kretschmer to the Vatican for a private audience at the end of September.
